Hi Asha — great to hear from you and congrats on the November cohort kickoff. We can absolutely support self-serve issuance and a short trial extension for a subset of your founders.

Checklist we need to verify eligibility (fastest path):
- Completed roster CSV with company name, founder contact email, incorporation country, and a quick note on use-case (one line). (see attached CSV template)
- Confirmation that each company is part of FoundersLab (one line in the sheet or a signed program attestation PDF)
- For companies requesting trial-extension, mark them in the roster with "EXTENSION_REQUEST" and note what milestone qualifies them (e.g., demo completed).

Operational details:
- We will provision individual redemption links (one per founder email) that expire 60 days after issuance.
- Standard credit amount: $5,000 USD per company unless you request custom sizing.
- Trial extension: +30 days to the trial window upon credit redemption — we can apply to up to 4 companies in the cohort as agreed.

Next steps for a fast turnaround: attach the roster file and a signed attestation (PDF). We’ll verify and generate the self-serve claim links within 24 hours of receiving everything. I’ve cc’d Marissa to loop in fulfillment.

Attachment: redwood_selfserve_instructions.md (quick steps for founders)

Thanks — Kim
